oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

InspectInclude.description: Sections to include in an inspect response.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

include.description: Sections to include. Empty/omitted = nodes+errors+warnings; params opt-in; non-empty = allowlist.

paths.description:
Explicit operator paths to inspect (required, non-empty). Soft-capped at 32.
No auto-recursion — caller chooses exactly which nodes to fetch.
